note: Shared vectors for the deterministic member id (FNV-1a 32-bit over Unicode CODE POINTS). Read by tests/test_mappers.py and by the TypeScript that must agree with it. These ids are PERSISTED and joined on, so a changed value here is a data migration, not a test edit.

vectors.why: the empty string — the FNV offset basis, unmixed
a second ASCII address, to pin that ids differ
accented Latin — BMP, where the two languages always agreed
ASTRAL: U+1F600. One code point in Python, a surrogate PAIR in UTF-16 — the only class that has ever diverged between the two
ASTRAL + ZWJ sequence: two astral code points either side of a BMP joiner
ASTRAL: CJK Extension B, U+20000 — a non-emoji astral case
